get.description: Lists the Books with OData query options over stored fields (camelCase): `$filter` (e.g. `isReading eq true`, `contains(title, 'Overstory')`), `$select`, `$orderby`, `$expand`, `$top` (default 50, at most 200), and `$skip`. Every row carries `id` (a number) and `url` (the Book's page); without `$select` that is all it carries. The stored fields are `title`, `author`, `isbn`, `genre`, `googleBooksLink`, `coverUrl`, `richDescriptionHtml` (the description as stored HTML, named `descriptionHtml` on the single get), `isFavorite`, `isPurchased`, `isReading`, `isCompleted`, `createdAt`, and `lastUpdatedAt`. A page that selects `richDescriptionHtml` holds at most five Books: lower `$top` or leave the description out. `nextOffset` is the `$skip` for the next page, or null on the last one.

post.description: Stores a Book from the fields you send, as the Edit page's form would; Google Books is never asked (the MCP tool `look_up_book` does the lookup). `title` is required: a missing or blank one answers 422 on that field. Text is trimmed and a blank field is stored empty; `descriptionHtml` is HTML and is sanitized. `coverUrl` is a web address (http or https) or the read address of an image the Account holds, else 422 on `coverUrl`; an image in `descriptionHtml` follows the same rule, else 422 on `descriptionHtml`. A status flag left out starts false. Answers 201 with the new Book. `coverUrl` may also be `upload:` for an image sent through an Upload link (`uploads.create`, target `image`), used once. An image may also be written `` for an image sent through an Upload link (`uploads.create`, target `image`): each upload is used once, and one that is unknown, unfinished, used, or not yours answers 422 on that field.

post.summary: Send a message to the Assistant
post.description: Sends `text` to our Assistant as the User, exactly as the panel does, and answers 202 once the message is stored and the Assistant's turn is on its way; read the reply with `GET …/messages?after={seq}&wait=60`. Answer the Assistant's questions and proposals with your next message. `pageContext` names what the message is about (the panel's Page context); `model`, when sent, must be the conversation's model. `uploadIds` are finished uploads with target `conversation`, each attached as a Conversation Attachment (at most 25 MiB, a PDF, image, text, Markdown, CSV, XLSX, or DOCX file). A send spends the Assistant allowance: an empty allowance answers 402 `allowance-exhausted`. A private conversation with a turn still running answers 409. A field problem answers 422.

get.description: The conversation's messages after `after` (a `seq`; omit it for all), oldest first, with the turn state (`running` or `idle`). With `wait` (seconds, at most 60), when there are no messages after `after` yet and the Assistant is still answering, the call holds until the Assistant writes a message, its turn ends, or `wait` passes; so after a send, read with `after` set to the send's `seq` and `wait=60`, and read again while `turnState` is `running`. Each message carries its role (`user`, `assistant`, or `room`), its sender, its markdown text, its attachments, and the tools the Assistant ran before it with their outcome. Thinking never comes back.
